text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the Japanese Derby, the participating Umamusume gather for a press conference to talk about their thoughts leading up to the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though the other participants are brimming with excitement and nerves, Grass Wonder alone gives calm, collected responses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa sees through Grass Wonder's polite facade, and comes by after the interviews to challenge her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder's fighting spirit burns quietly as we further prepare for the Japanese Derby.
